decisions.reason: Because the accelerator stayed on the home page in both 2023 and 2024 and supports the firm's publicly stated circular-growth ecosystem, management would continue it rather than reverse a visible commitment.

Although somewhat less central than the machinery products, the binder kept its own page across both years and fits the firm's R&D-led low-emission positioning, which encourages continued commitment despite uncertainty.

This decontamination plant is close to the core business, was launched with strong public claims and remained on the home page in 2024, so sunk development effort and visible strategic commitment favor persistence.

Even though it is close to the firm's core and was prominently launched in 2023, its complete disappearance from the website in 2024 signals that public commitment has weakened enough for management to stop backing it and redeploy resources.
